subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 & audit evidence for ZenHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenhealth.com>, Sofia Lopez <sofia.lopez@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 & audit evidence for ZenHealth

Hi Amit / Sofia, thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Key pain points you mentioned:
- Need SOC 2 attestation for a hosted inference provider and clear evidence for audit scope (CCPA/HIPAA considerations).
- Audit log retention and access: 12+ months for security/forensics and ability to export per-tenant logs.
- Security controls: encryption at rest, KMS options, RBAC and IAM audit trails.
- DPA and contractual timelines for signature and acceptable SLA language.

Goals we aligned on:
- Share SOC 2 report and pen test summary for your review (we have a recent SOC 2 Type II report and a high-level pen test summary).
- Provide a sample of redacted audit logs and confirm fields/format.
- Confirm retention policy (target: 13 months) and whether you need per-tenant separation or aggregate exports.
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with an engineer to review logs, retention, and KMS integration.

What Redwood will provide next (owners & timing):
- Redwood SOC 2 report (attached) - owner: Marissa - EOD tomorrow (11/26).
- Pen test executive summary (attached) - owner: Marissa - EOD tomorrow (11/26).
- Redacted audit-logs sample (CSV) + explanation of schema - owner: Engineering (cc Neha) - by 11/26.
- DPA draft for initial review (attached) - owner: Legal via Neha - we will route for comments; please share any required clauses.
- Proposed tech deep-dive: Dec 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT (see proposed calendar link below).

Immediate asks for you: 
1) Confirm the retention window you need (you mentioned ~13 months).
2) Confirm attendees for the Dec 2 deep-dive (we suggest security + SRE + one product owner).

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf, Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf, redwood-audit-logs-sample.csv, DPA-draft-Redwood.docx

If that looks right, I'll get the attachments over and lock the deep-dive slot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for production LLMs
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Lopez <sofia.lopez@zenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 & audit evidence for ZenHealth

Thanks Marissa, appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications before we dive deeper: 

- Retention: we require 13 months of searchable audit logs (so 395 days to be precise). Is that configurable per-customer or baked into hosted retention?
- Log contents: we need per-request metadata (timestamp, request_id, user_id, model_id, latency, status). Do your logs include request_id and user identifiers? Do you ever log request/response payloads by default?
- Format: CSV/JSON is fine, but we prefer a newline-delimited JSON export for ingestion into our SIEM. Can you provide that format?
- Encryption / KMS: can you confirm options for customer-managed keys for hosted vs private deployment? We also need a statement about encryption at rest and key rotation policy.
- DPA: we're generally quick but will need the DPA routed to procurement and legal. Do you have a standard DPA you can share?

Attendees for the deep-dive: Amit Shah (Security Lead), Sofia Lopez (SRE), Diego Ramos (Platform Engineer).

Can you also confirm whether pen test evidence includes CVEs and remediation timelines, or if it's just an executive summary?

Thanks,
Amit
Amit Shah
Security Lead, ZenHealth
amit.shah@zenhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Lopez <sofia.lopez@zenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 & audit evidence for ZenHealth

Thanks Amit, great questions. Answers below and next steps. 

Retention:
- We support configurable retention windows. Hosted customers can request up to 13 months (we'll confirm SLA for hosted exports). Dedicated/Private deployments can configure retention to your exact policy since you control the storage.

Log contents / format:
- Our audit logs include timestamp, request_id, user_id (if provided by your integration), model_id, latency, status, and routing metadata. We do NOT store request/response payloads by default for hosted customers; payload logging is an opt-in capability for Dedicated/Private with appropriate redaction controls.
- We'll provide the sample logs as newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) and as CSV. See attached redwood-audit-logs-sample.csv for a redacted example; engineering will upload an ndjson export if that's preferred.

Encryption / KMS:
- Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS by default; customer-managed KMS is available for Dedicated and Private. For Private deployments we support HSM-backed keys and BYOK flows. Key rotation policies are documented in the SOC 2 report; we'll surface the exact rotation cadence in the technical call.

Pen test evidence:
- The attached PenTest summary includes high/medium/low findings and remediation timelines for items in scope. We have a redacted findings list; if you need CVE-level detail we can provide more under an NDA / SCA.

DPA & legal:
- DPA draft attached (DPA-draft-Redwood.docx). Neha will route to legal and coordinate changes - Marissa / Neha will handle procurement cadence.

Proposed next step: Technical deep-dive on Dec 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=zenhealth-tech-dive-20261202

Deliverables we'll send by EOD today (11/26): SOC2 report, pen test summary, audit logs sample (CSV + ndjson), DPA draft.

Please confirm the attendee list and we'll lock the invite.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf, Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf, redwood-audit-logs-sample.csv, DPA-draft-Redwood.docx
